title: Forwarder DAO parsing looser than root extract_updates: reject E=1/unknown option types or document spec blessing
description: Security review of wave: dao_parents_for_source (rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:1185-1193) ignores unknown option types, accepts E=1 external transits and inconsistent path_sequence/lifetime across transits, caps group_targets only by DAO size not MAX_DAO_UPDATES. Consequence: forwarders relay DAOs the root will reject (bounded amplification toward root) and anti-spoof parent set can include parents from transits the root would reject. No acceptance hazard (drop-only, root re-validates) but tighten for defense in depth: reject E=1 and unknown types in forwarder, or add comment citing spec section blessing the asymmetry.
